title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
blurb: Showed that smaller decoder-only models trained on more tokens can match much larger ones, using a block design (RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU) that most open models now share.
intro: The LLaMA block is a pre-norm decoder block with three substitutions: RMSNorm for LayerNorm, rotary position embeddings applied to queries and keys, and a SwiGLU feed-forward network. LLaMA 2 added grouped-query attention for its larger models. Each step builds one of these parts in isolation; the capstone stacks them into a full forward pass, and the last step shows how the model is decoded with a KV cache.
